description: Phase 3 player detection, footpoint reliability, team assignment, multi-object tracking, and field projection benchmark manifest with strict train/val/test split separation. Zero thresholds are tuned on TEST.

benchmark_provenance_and_semantics.controlled_sequences_detector: FixturePlayerDetector (fixture_detector_v1) — synthetic bounding-box fixture harness used strictly to evaluate downstream footpoint gating, torso cluster assignment, multi-object tracking, and field projection under controlled dropouts. Fixture pass-through precision/recall/F1 must NOT be interpreted as image-based player detector accuracy.
benchmark_provenance_and_semantics.real_nfl_frames_detector: TurfContrastPlayerDetector (turf_contrast_baseline_v1) — evaluated on 4 real NFL single frames (rf_01..rf_04) strictly as an unannotated end-to-end integration/smoke test and projection refusal-gate audit (quantitative detection/team/tracking/position accuracy unmeasured on rf_01..rf_04).
benchmark_provenance_and_semantics.team_metric_semantics: Permutation-invariant binary torso appearance/luminance cluster assignment accuracy (TEAM_A = darker/lower-L centroid, TEAM_B = lighter/higher-L centroid). Does NOT represent home/away, offense/defense, or real NFL franchise identity.
benchmark_provenance_and_semantics.idsw_and_frag_semantics: CLEAR-MOTA lifetime identity convention: a ground-truth object re-associated to a newly initialized track_id after a dropout exceeding max_missed_frames=3 increments both track_fragmentations (FRAG) and lifetime id_switches (IDSW). Active-track association swaps (active_swap_idsw) and post-expiration reinitialization switches (post_expiry_reinit_idsw) are reported separately.
statistical_scope_limitations: 60 controlled sequence frames + 4 real NFL frames constitute a Phase-3 engineering verification benchmark, not evidence of broad NFL generalization.
100% short-occlusion recovery rate is based on 2/2 events in VAL and 1/1 event in TEST and must not be presented as statistically robust.

split_protocol.train: Used for baseline detector morphology and tracker association parameter selection.
split_protocol.val: Used for verifying footpoint unreliability flags, short-occlusion bridging, and team margin thresholds.
split_protocol.test: Strictly held-out frozen evaluation split; zero thresholds tuned on TEST.

tracking_sequences.title: Train Sequence 1 — 6 Players Linear Pre-Snap Shift on Calibrated Field
tracking_sequences.description: 6 players (3 dark-jersey TEAM_A, 3 white-jersey TEAM_B) moving smoothly across 10 calibrated frames.

tracking_sequences.title: Val Sequence 2 — 2-Frame Short Occlusion & Recovery (2 Players Drop Out at t=4..5)
tracking_sequences.description: 6 players where 2 players are occluded for 2 frames (t=4..5) and re-detected at t=6; tracker preserves track_id and refuses field_position during coasting.

tracking_sequences.title: Val Sequence 3 — Player Crossing & Bottom-Border Truncation Footpoint Refusal
tracking_sequences.description: 6 players including 1 bottom-border-truncated player (t=0..9) and 2 crossing players (t=4..5) whose lower-body-occluded footpoint is flagged unreliable and refused for field projection.

tracking_sequences.title: Test Sequence 4 — 3-Frame Max Short Occlusion Recovery + Striped Official UNKNOWN
tracking_sequences.description: 7 subjects (3 dark TEAM_A, 3 light TEAM_B, 1 striped official assigned UNKNOWN) with a 3-frame detection dropout (t=3..5) recovered at t=6 with 0 ID switches.

tracking_sequences.title: Test Sequence 5 — Calibration Dropout at t=4..6 (Image Tracking Persists, Projection Refused)
tracking_sequences.description: 6 players tracked continuously across 10 frames while field calibration is invalid at t=4..6; image tracks survive with 0 ID switches while field_position is refused during t=4..6.

tracking_sequences.title: Test Sequence 6 — Prolonged 5-Frame Occlusion Expiry + Clutter Rejection
tracking_sequences.description: 6 players where 1 player drops out for 5 frames (t=2..6 > max_missed_frames=3, expiring cleanly and re-initializing at t=7) plus 1 single-frame false-positive detection and 1 missed detection.
